{{Quote|Tuomi represents five inhabited planets and nearly a billion citizens. Why should Alderaan rule Bosch, he asks.|Leia Organa to Gial Ackbar|<ref name="SoL" />}}
The '''Bosch system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> Between [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]] and [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Shield of Lies]]'' to between [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]] and [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].</ref> it, as well as a total of five inhabited [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and approximately one billion citizens, was represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tuomi]]. While challenging the authority of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], Tuomi rhetorically asked why should the former [[Alderaanian/Legends|inhabitants]] of Organa's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]],<ref name="SoL" /> the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system's]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], have the same voting rights in the Senate as the Bosch [[Star system/Legends|system]]. In a discussion with Organa, however, New Republic [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] reassured her, proclaiming that Tuomi was only an "ignorant fingerling."<ref name="SoL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The name "Bosch" was introduced in the [[1996]] novel ''[[Shield of Lies]]'', authored by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]] as the second installment in [[The Black Fleet Crisis|''The Black Fleet Crisis Trilogy'']].<ref name="SoL" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], first identified it as a [[Star/Legends|star]] system and placed it in grid square K-10.<ref name="TEA" />
